item.title: Mike Wengren Looks Back On Disturbed’s Struggle In Chicago: 'We Weren’t Part Of The Cool Kids'
item.description: In a new chat with Modern Drummer, drummer Mike Wengren opened up about how Disturbed went from handing out cassette tapes outside clubs to landing a major record deal.
